description: This file defines the ContentDescription class, which models metadata related to content items within the sales management system. It includes fields for SEO-related tags such as URLs, keywords, titles, and descriptions, and links to a Content object.

classes.name: ContentDescription
classes.description: A model class representing descriptive metadata for content, including SEO tags and link to content content.

methods.name: getMetatagTitle
methods.description: Returns the meta title for content description.

methods.name: setMetatagTitle
methods.description: Sets the meta title for content description.

methods.name: setContent
methods.description: Associates a Content object with this description.
